message: The other day, I was in the kitchen making dinner when I realized I hadn’t checked our smoke alarms in a while. So, I popped into our family group chat and suggested a little fire safety check-in. 😂 We ended up sharing our escape plans, and it turned into a fun brainstorming session about how we’d all get out in a hurry (and who would grab the dog!). It’s nice to know we all care about being prepared, even if it’s just a quick chat. Have you talked with your family about your escape plans lately?
